boundary_conditions.description: Coupled boundary condition for rotational or translational periodic sector geometries.
boundary_conditions.notes: Used for meshed angular slices (e.g. 60° sectors of vortex tubes, turbines). Preserves tangential/swirling velocity components across sector faces.

boundary_conditions.description: Inflow boundary with specified velocity and temperature, zeroGradient pressure.
Outflow boundary with specified back-pressure, zeroGradient velocity and temperature.
Solid boundary with no-slip velocity and turbulence wall functions.
Mirror plane for a geometrically and physically symmetric domain.
boundary_conditions.notes: Use symmetryPlane consistently for every solved field. It is not an inlet, outlet, or physical wall and should only be used when the solution is symmetric.

boundary_conditions.description: Front/back patch for a one-cell-thick two-dimensional domain.
boundary_conditions.notes: Use empty consistently on both out-of-plane patches and for every solved field; it cannot be mixed with a three-dimensional mesh on the same direction.

boundary_conditions.description: No-penetration wall with a prescribed tangential velocity, as used by lid-driven and rotating-wall cases.
boundary_conditions.notes: Use movingWallVelocity when the wall motion is specified by mesh motion; otherwise use fixedValue U with the physical wall velocity. Pressure remains zeroGradient.
